hardware: 8× NVIDIA H200 GPUs for calibration/search timing
single NVIDIA H200 GPU for practical inference-speed evaluation

settings.name: calibration/search data
settings.description: 1024 randomly sampled GQA examples; D=100 threshold grid in (0,1).

settings.name: cross-backbone aggressive setting
settings.description: Qwen3-VL and InternVL-30B at 88% expert skipping; GPT-OSS-20B backbone at 75%.

settings.name: speed test
settings.description: single H200; Kimi 83% and Qwen3-VL 88% skipping; prefill batch size 8; decoding sequence length 1024.

settings.name: quantization
settings.description: MC-MoE weight-only mixed-precision quantization for MoE FFNs plus 4-bit weight-only quantization elsewhere; 2.5-bit and 1.5-bit expert settings compared.

data.correctness: Lossy approximation: expert computations are intentionally removed, so exact output equivalence is not expected. Quality is assessed by normalized benchmark performance at matched skip ratios.
data.methodology: 13 image/video understanding benchmarks, multiple MoE MLLM backbones, matched skipping ratios, component ablations, quantization combination, calibration/search cost, and actual H200 prefill/decode speed are evaluated. MMBench/MMVet generated text is judged with DeepSeek-V3.1.
data.scope: Evidence supports training-free expert skipping for multimodal MoE inference and single-node GPU speedups. It does not establish benefits for distributed expert-parallel all-to-all serving, and threshold calibration requires representative multimodal samples.
